warning: These are three different metrics and they are stored apart on purpose. None of them is a rent level in euros. Eurostat does not publish a comparable rent level, and deriving one from an index would be inventing a number.

rentIndex.unitMeaning: Harmonised index of consumer prices for actual rentals, 2015 = 100
rentIndex.methodology: HICP subindex. It measures how rents paid have moved since 2015 in that country, and says nothing about what rent costs relative to another country.

rentInflation.unitMeaning: Annual average rate of change in actual rentals, percent
rentInflation.methodology: Year on year change in the same subindex.

housingCostOverburden.unitMeaning: Share of the population living in households where total housing costs exceed 40 percent of disposable income, percent
housingCostOverburden.methodology: EU statistics on income and living conditions. It is an affordability measure rather than a price, and it counts owners as well as renters.

notCovered.rentLevel: No comparable rent level in euros exists in Eurostat. The housing price level index in prc_ppp_ind covers housing, water and energy together and cannot be split into rent.
notCovered.cityLevel: None of these three is published below the country.
notCovered.askingRent: Asking rents exist only on marketplaces, whose terms forbid scraping and whose sample is advertised prices rather than rents paid.
